Description: A mighty warrior who is powered by a primal force of the multiverse that manifest as a Rage.
Is honed with deadly focus and harness primal powers to protect the world from the ravages of monsters and tyrants.
An expert in inspiring others, soothing hurts, disheartening foes, and creating illusions.
Can reach out to the divine magic of the Outer Planes and channel it to bolster people and battle foes.
Calls on the forces of nature, harnessing magic to heal, transform into animals, and wield elemental destruction.
Has an unparalleled prowess with weapons and armor, and is well acquainted with death, both meting it out and defying it.
Focuses their internal reservoirs of power to create extraordinary, even supernatural, effects.
Lives on the front lines of the cosmic struggle, united by their oath against the forces of annihilation.
Has a knack for finding the solution to just about any problem, prioritizing subtle strikes over brute strength.
Harnesses and channels the raw, roiling power of innate magic that is stamped into their very being.
Has a quest for knowledge that lies hidden in the fabric of the multiverse, piecing together arcane secrets to bolster their own power.
Cast spells of explosive fire, arcing lightning, subtle deception, and spectacular transformations.
